newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan sets conversion deadline for PTC vouchers.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan sets conversion deadline for PTC vouchers.

text.p: The Privatisation Commission of Pakistan on Wednesday asked holders of PTC vouchers to convert them into Pakistan Telecommunication Company Ltd (PTCL) shares by June 9.
It said the Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad stock exchanges would stop trading in PTC vouchers after that date.
The Karachi Stock Exchange said trading in PTC vouchers would be placed on a spot basis from May 21 to June 9.

The PTC issued 100-share vouchers in domestic and foreign placements in August and September 1994. They became convertible into shares after the PTC was registered as the PTCL in August 1996 as part of preparations for its privatisation.
State-run PTCL declared a final dividend of six percent for the year ended June 30, subject to approval by an annual general meeting scheduled for June 24. Book closure is June 10 to 23.
Dealer Hina Akhlaq of brokerage KASB & Co said PTCL share prices were likely to slide while the vouchers are being traded on a spot basis as speculators lacked holding power.
PTCL is a favourite stock among speculators.
On Wednesday, PTCL's 10-rupee shares rose 0.40 rupees to 25.05 in early trade on the Karachi bourse.
